Claude Opus 4.8.description: Anthropic's most powerful 'work' model. It is by far the best model for coding and writing, excelling at complex reasoning, detailed analysis, and nuanced content creation.
features: Best-in-class for writing, editing, and coding
Does not train on user data by default

Claude Sonnet 4.6.description: Anthropic's fast 'chat' model. It's designed for quick, conversational interactions, brainstorming, and everyday tasks. It is the default model in the Claude interface and hits near-Opus quality on most agentic coding tasks at a fraction of the cost.
features: Best for expressive writing and brainstorming

Claude Haiku 4.5.description: Anthropic's fastest and cheapest model. Haiku 4.5 delivers near-frontier performance for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like classification, extraction, and quick Q&A.
features: Lowest per-token cost in the Claude family
Great for batch processing and high-volume workflows

Gemini 3.1 Pro.description: Google's latest powerful 'work' model. Gemini 3.1 Pro features improved reasoning, directness, and multimodal coherence compared to 2.5. It maintains the massive context window while being more efficient and less verbose by default.
features: Better multimodal synthesis (text, images, audio, video)
Can create video with the Veo 3 model

Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite.description: Google's cheapest Gemini tier. Flash-Lite retains a long context window and runs even faster than Flash, making it a natural fit for high-volume agentic calls and cost-sensitive background automations.

Gemini 3.1 Flash.description: Google's latest fast 'chat' model. Gemini 3.1 Flash is more direct and efficient than 2.5 Flash, with improved multimodal capabilities and an excellent voice mode that can use your phone's camera for real-time input.
features: Excellent multimodal voice mode with camera support
Good for quick questions and brainstorming

Gemini 3.1 (Veo).description: Google's video generation capability, available exclusively in Gemini 3.1. Veo can create short, photorealistic video clips from text descriptions. This is an experimental feature accessed through the Gemini interface.

Gemini 2.5 Pro (legacy).description: Google's previous-generation 'work' model. While still capable, Gemini 3.1 Pro is recommended for new work due to its improved reasoning and efficiency.

Gemini 2.5 Flash (legacy).description: Google's previous-generation fast 'chat' model. Gemini 3.1 Flash is recommended for new work due to better directness and efficiency.

GPT 5.5.description: OpenAI's current flagship 'work' model for deep reasoning and complex tasks. Use it for multi-step logical deduction and investigative research. Released on top of GPT 5.4, which also remains available.

GPT 5.4.description: OpenAI's previous flagship, still fully supported. A good drop-in option when 5.5 isn't available in your region or plan, or when cost/latency matter more than absolute peak quality.
features: Slightly cheaper / faster than 5.5 in practice

Codex (GPT 5.5).description: OpenAI's specialized coding model powered by GPT 5.5. This is the recommended OpenAI tool for all coding tasks, offering superior code generation, debugging, and project scaffolding.
features: Better code quality than general-purpose models

Gemini (Nano Banana).description: Google's latest, fastest, and most efficient image model, also known as Gemini 2.5 Flash Image. Its native multimodal architecture allows for powerful conversational editing, multi-image composition, and accurate text rendering.

NotebookLM.description: Google's research and writing assistant that is grounded in your chosen source documents. It helps you get summaries, ask questions, and generate ideas based only on the material you provide, reducing hallucinations.
features: Generates summaries, FAQs, and audio overviews
Excellent for analyzing collections of documents

Grok 3.description: Developed by xAI, Grok is the only major LLM with real-time integration with a social media platform (X/Twitter), making it an indispensable tool for monitoring breaking news.

Perplexity.description: An AI-powered search engine that provides direct answers to queries with citations. It's designed for research and finding information, functioning as a 'conversational search engine'.
features: Provides answers with inline source citations
Excellent for fact-checking and initial research
Focus mode for searching specific domains (e.g., academic papers)

Open source models.description: A category of open-weight models that can be run locally on your own hardware or via community-hosted providers. Frontier open models now rival closed providers on specific tasks, and they are ideal for privacy-sensitive workflows or when you need to keep source material off third-party servers.
features: Can run on local hardware (via Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)
Frontier-tier options for coding now exist (GLM-5.1, DeepSeek V4, Qwen3-Coder)
No per-token costs once running locally

GLM-5.1 (open source).description: Z.ai's GLM-5.1 is the best open-weight model for agentic coding as of April 2026. MIT-licensed and pitched for long-horizon autonomous engineering sessions, it is the strongest self-hostable option for newsrooms that need to keep code and source material off third-party servers.
features: Best open-weight agentic coding as of April 2026

Qwen3-Coder (open source).description: Alibaba's Qwen3-Coder is an open-weight family of coding models with multiple sizes, from laptop-friendly variants to data-center giants. Strong benchmark scores, long context for whole-repo reasoning, and a liberal license make it a practical choice for self-hosted IDE assistance.
features: Multiple sizes from laptop to data center
Open weights with a liberal license
Good for IDE autocomplete and refactoring

DeepSeek V4 (open source).description: DeepSeek V4 is an open-weight frontier-tier coding model with 81% on SWE-Bench Verified — on par with closed providers but at a fraction of the cost. Open weights let you self-host for privacy, and the DeepSeek API is one of the cheapest ways to get frontier coding performance.
features: Open weights with a very low-cost API

ElevenLabs.description: A specialized AI tool for high-quality, realistic voice synthesis. It's the industry leader for generating voiceovers, podcast audio, and other narrated content.
features: Fine-grained control over voice emotion and pacing

Midjourney.description: A premier AI image generation service known for producing highly artistic, detailed, and aesthetically pleasing images. It operates primarily through the Discord platform.
features: Strong control over style and composition
